checks.must: When the region swaps to SettingsView, the React root is unmounted (e.g. a Marionette wrapper view calling root.unmount() in onDestroy/onBeforeDestroy).
The Radio 'message:new' subscription and the 30 s poll interval are removed on unmount — no zombie listeners or duplicated polls after navigating back and forth.
Unread count stays on the shared app.mailbox model (other code may read it), not only in React state.
Notices that Marionette evaluates className only at element creation (so has-unread was stale) and either preserves it or asks/flags before changing it.
No unrequested behaviour changes without calling them out.
